lines: Naal salook de bol ve maahi
Asin haan pardesi pakhhi
couplets.en: Speak gently, beloved, for we are birds far from home.

lines: Tain dilbar de dekhan kaaran
Asaan bahut udeek rakhi
couplets.en: Beloved, I have waited long for a glimpse of you.

lines: Jad tak tu nazri na aaven ve
Thak jaavan saadi akhin
couplets.en: My eyes grow weary waiting for you to come into view.

lines: Ghulam Farid, oh kade nahin murre
Jinhaan lazzat ishq di chakkhi
couplets.en: Ghulam Farid, those who have tasted love never turn back.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
Aa ja vekh mera intezaar, aa ja
couplets.en: If you doubt my longing, come and see how I wait for you.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
Aa ja vekh mera intezaar, aa ja
couplets.en: If you doubt my longing, come and see how I wait for you.

lines: Aiven laran bahaane labhna ain
Ki tu sochna ain, sitamgaar, aa ja
couplets.en: You look for reasons to quarrel, cruel beloved, when you could simply come.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
Aa ja vekh mera intezaar, aa ja
couplets.en: If you doubt my longing, come and see how I wait for you.

lines: Aiven laran bahaane labhna ain
Ki tu sochna ain, sitamgaar, aa ja
couplets.en: You look for reasons to quarrel, cruel beloved, when you could simply come.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
couplets.en: You doubt the depth of my longing.

lines: Bhaaven hijr te bhaaven visaal hove
Vakho-vakh dohaan diyaan lazzataan ne
couplets.en: Parting and union each have a sweetness of their own.

lines: Bhaaven hijr, hijr
couplets.en: Even in parting.

lines: Bhaaven hijr te bhaaven visaal hove
Vakho-vakh dohaan diyaan lazzataan ne
couplets.en: Parting and union each have a sweetness of their own.

lines: Mere sohniya ja hazaar vaari
Aa ja pyaariya te lakh vaar aa ja
couplets.en: Go a thousand times, my love, and come back a hundred thousand.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
Aa ja vekh mera intezaar, aa ja
couplets.en: If you doubt my longing, come and see how I wait for you.

Ki tu sochna ain, sitamgaar, aa ja

lines: Eh rivaaj ae masjidaan mandaraan da
Othe hastiyaan te khud-parastiyaan ne
couplets.en: Such is the way of mosques and temples, where people set themselves above others and worship their own importance.

lines: Eh rivaaj ae masjidaan mandaraan da
Othe hastiyaan te khud-parastiyaan ne
couplets.en: Such is the way of mosques and temples, where people set themselves above others and worship their own importance.

lines: Maikhaane vich masti hi masti ae
couplets.en: The tavern is filled with rapture.

lines: Maikhaane vich masti hi masti ae
Hosh kar, ban ke hoshiyaar, aa ja
couplets.en: The tavern is filled with rapture, so come with your wits about you.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
couplets.en: You doubt the depth of my longing.

lines: Tu saada te tera dil saada
Tainu aiven raqeeb kuraah paaya
couplets.en: You are guileless and so is your heart, and my rival has led you astray.

lines: Tu saada te tera dil saada
Tainu aiven raqeeb kuraah paaya
couplets.en: You are guileless and so is your heart, and my rival has led you astray.

lines: Je tu mere janaaze te nahin aaya
couplets.en: If you missed my funeral.

lines: Je tu mere janaaze te nahin aaya
Raah takda ae teri mazaar, aa ja
couplets.en: If you missed my funeral, come, for my grave is still waiting for you.

lines: Mere shauq da nahin aitbaar tainu
couplets.en: You doubt the depth of my longing.

lines: Sukhi vasna je tu chaahna ain
Mere Ghaliba es jahaan andar
couplets.en: If you wish to live at peace in this world, my dear Ghalib.

lines: Sukhi vasna je tu chaahna ain
Mere Ghaliba es jahaan andar
couplets.en: If you wish to live at peace in this world, my dear Ghalib.

lines: Aa ja rindaan di bazm vich aa beh ja
couplets.en: Come and sit among the drinkers.

lines: Aa ja rindaan di bazm vich aa beh ja
Ithe baithde ne khaaksaar, aa ja
couplets.en: Come and sit among the drinkers, for this is where the humble gather.
